description: This Java source file defines the DisconnectListenerService class, which extends WearableListenerService. It monitors connectivity changes between an Android Wear device and its paired phone by utilizing GoogleApiClient and Wearable APIs. The class manages notifications to alert the user if the device loses connection to the phone, specifically when the 'find_me' capability is no longer reachable. It implements callbacks for connection events and handles querying connected nodes to determine connectivity status.

classes.name: DisconnectListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for connectivity changes between the wear device and the phone, updating notifications based on connection status, especially concerning the 'find_me' capability.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient used for connecting to Wearable APIs.

methods.name: onConnectedNodes
methods.description: Callback invoked when the list of connected nodes is available; triggers capability check if connected.

methods.name: setOrUpdateNotification
methods.description: Queries the capability API to determine reachability of the 'find_me' capability and updates notifications accordingly.

methods.name: updateFindMeCapability
methods.description: Processes capability info to decide whether to clear or set a notification indicating lost connection.

methods.name: setupLostConnectivityNotification
methods.description: Creates a notification that informs the user that the connection to the phone has been lost.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback that triggers a capability check when GoogleApiClient connects.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Placeholder for handling suspension of GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the GoogleApiClient connection upon service destruction.
